title: What are React Native Best Practices?
overview: Best practices are recommended approaches that help developers write clean, maintainable, scalable, and high-performance React Native applications.

example.title: Why Best Practices Matter
example.content:
Benefits:
• Better code organization
• Easier debugging
• Improved performance
• Maintainable applications

title: Project Structure and Organization
overview: A proper project structure keeps files organized and makes applications easier to maintain as they grow. Developers should separate components, screens, services, assets, and utilities.

example.title: Recommended Structure
example.content:
src/
 ├── components
 ├── screens
 ├── navigation
 ├── services
 ├── utils
 └── assets

title: Reusable Components
overview: Reusable components reduce code duplication and improve consistency across the application. Components should be designed to handle different data using props.

example.title: Reusable Component Example
example.content:
Instead of creating multiple buttons:

Create one Button component and pass:
• title
• color
• onPress

title: Performance Optimization
overview: Optimizing React Native applications improves speed, reduces unnecessary renders, and provides a better user experience.

example.title: Optimization Techniques
example.content:
✔ Use FlatList for large lists.
✔ Avoid unnecessary re-renders.
✔ Optimize images.
✔ Use memoization when required.

title: Code Quality and Maintenance
overview: Writing clean and consistent code makes applications easier to understand and maintain. Developers should follow naming conventions, remove unused code, and keep logic separated.

example.title: Code Quality Rules
example.content:
✔ Use meaningful names.
✔ Keep components small.
✔ Separate business logic.
✔ Maintain consistent formatting.

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned important React Native best practices including project organization, reusable components, performance optimization, and writing clean maintainable code.

example.title: Quick Revision
example.content:

✔ Create reusable components.
✔ Optimize application performance.
✔ Write clean and maintainable code.
✔ Follow consistent coding practices.
